title: The Three Griefs and the Four Weepings: Divine Sorrow over the Bound Living Soul
description: Two paired treatments of divine compassion. The Three Griefs are powers inclined of heart proceeding from the Father: Mother of Life weeping for her captive children, the First Man mourning for his Five Sons in the Vessel of Light, and a third grieving power. The Four Weepings of the garments / sons of the First Man: three at the descent (foreseeing the captivity, then silent under Necessity), and a heavier fourth at the consummation when souls who loved Darkness are sealed away from rest forever.
